args.text:
Loyal-seat rules (default):
1. Play safe on every card unless I am a saboteur; damage only hurts the convoy.
2. Track who crewed with whom and which stages had damage. A stage with damage shows at least one saboteur on its crew; a clean stage clears its crew somewhat.
3. Vote no on a lead who puts a seat with prior damage history on a crew again, or who names only themselves and close allies.
4. Use the audit on the most suspicious seat that crewed a damaged stage, not on a random one.
5. Be wary of a lead who proposes a large crew with no reason; spread trust, don't hoard it.
6. Accuse seats whose record best fits the damage counts after the crossing.
Saboteur rules: play damage only when cooldown allows and when the stage is unlikely to be scrutinized; play safe on early stages to build trust; never be the only damage on a crew that already has damage from others.
